notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
• Fixed a bug due to which the disappearance of the zombie text remained on the screen.
• Added mouse inversion setting.
• Now running-in is carried out not only with the right shift, but also with the left one.
• Added a special effect when monsters disappear.
• Accelerated closing of elevator doors. This should prevent the texture from falling out.
• Changed the sound of pistol shots.

notes.title: Update 1.1.8
notes.content:
• Music at the end of the game has been changed, now you can safely stream the game.
• Fixed problems with zombies.
• Time for removing zombies has been changed from 180 seconds to 15 seconds.
• Added one more can of gasoline.
• Fixed bug of the protagonist walking through the doors.
• Fixed minor bugs with the game.
• Fixed collision of objects in many places.

notes.title: Update 1.1.7
notes.content:
• Fixed bug with the code on the 7th floor related to the projector.
• Fixed a bug with loading, saving, previously it was possible to load for textures.
• Changed 8th floor, now monsters do not get stuck.
• Fixed lighting at the radio, on / off.
• Improved optimization on the 4th floor.
• Fixed a bug on the 4th floor, passage through textures and doors.
• Plugin VR is disabled.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
• The health of the last boss is reduced by 150 units.
• The range and brightness of the flashlight is increased by 40%.
• Fixed on / off flashlight.
• Reduced the area of ​​interaction with the key, where the last boss had, previously, if the inventory was full, the key prevented the light from turning on.
• Elevator speed increased by 200%.
• Piano numbers are now easier to see.
• Fixed getting stuck zombies on the 8th floor.
• Fixed getting stuck monsters in items that can be taken.
• Fixed collision of stairs in 1 library.
• Fixed collision on the 3rd floor, earlier it was possible to get stuck.
• Fixed collision on floor 0, earlier it was possible to get stuck.
• Changed the spatter of blood on the wall of the 0 floor, where there are 7 corpses.
• Fixed collision on the 2nd floor, earlier it was possible to climb over the bags.
• Changed collision on the 4th floor. The bug has also been fixed.
• The camera of the toy car has been fixed.
• Fixed a bug with a puzzle that lowers water into the boiler room.
• Removed hotkeys for weapons.
• Added setting to enable / disable black kinematic stripes.
• Added setting for turning on / off the rocking of the character's camera.
• Inventory is expanded by 1 slot.
• The speed of the witch is reduced by 5%.
